levels.name: Society
levels.description: // Why are you always awake at night? //

levels.name: Thinking Space II
levels.description: A mindscape of pure insanity, most fall to it's brutal nature. Gameplay by CoCy team, Deco hosted by DrCuber, Verified by Zoink. Dedicated to Hideki <3

levels.name: NervHell
levels.description: Official Nhelv Extension. Verified by ChopBlox.

levels.name: Codependence
levels.description: Duelo Maestro but better | Verified by Kapinapi and ViralDL | Have fun!

levels.name: Bloom
levels.description: A minimalist atmospheric XXL solo extreme that won $300 in KrmaL's Contest 3. Consists of slow paced, experimental gameplay, a terrifying learning curve, and some randomization. Its style takes great inspiration from a level of the same name by KrmaL in Soundodger+

levels.name: Sank
levels.description: The hardest rated cube-only level at the time of its release. Takes major inspiration from Dump and DsinK. Has precise orb timings, and some silly Spongebob characters near the end.

levels.name: X84
levels.description: Extremely fast-paced & high cps extreme with an intense Camellia song. Memorable for its relentlessly learny but renowned gameplay, paired with jittery effects and flashes. Could be described as "Xronier's distant cousin."

levels.name: End of the Universe
levels.description: Edge of the World remake hosted by Fusion425, taking almost 2 years to complete. Retains EOTW's upbeat song, gameplay, and flashy blue/purple space-themed visuals. Gameplay is very well-received!

levels.name: Apotheosis
levels.description: Fast-paced glow extreme with flashy visuals throughout. Contains claustrophobic high-cps gameplay and contrasts dark details with saturated effects.

levels.name: 2 Comme le vent
levels.description: Remake of an obscure 1.9 level '1 Comme le vent', with more two player gameplay and an incredibly hard wave at 78%. Intended for solo play.

levels.name: Death Corridor Z
levels.description: Robbed Top 1 verified way back in 2017 that took nearly 9 years to get rated. Features several incredibly difficult wave chokepoints and a black and white colour scheme.

levels.name: ROCKY ROAD
levels.description: Fast paced, well-received timing extreme created by arclight & cdyzz.

levels.name: Alpha
levels.description: A traditional-styled level which has faced over 6 years of on-and-off building and countless buffs, nerfs and rebalances. Despite everything it went through it managed to become highly enjoyed amongst its victors. Very timing-based with the main highlight being the 39% dual, though it has several short bursts of more skill-based gameplay throughout.

levels.name: Retention Redux
levels.description: Faithful retention remake passion project aimed to capture the essence of the original. Inspired from the creator's experience beating Retention as a first extreme. Gameplay takes light inspiration from the original while being very well-received, and the decoration boosts the object density and vibrancy. Built entirely on mobile!

levels.name: Piano Woman
levels.description: The sequel to Piano Man. A true solo, with pukklez making the song, the level, and being the verifier. Every input is 2.5 frames on 60fps.

levels.name: SisuSonic
levels.description: Finnish megacollab inspired by the sonic series, started in 2018 and finished in 2024. The hardest but also possibly the most obscure sonic series spinoff.

levels.name: SHIP
levels.description: The second rated ship-only extreme not afraid to throw evil swoops in every corner you look. Since it’s a Cersia level, it’s from the 1.9 GDPS. Also technically the shortest XL extreme. Beware of the Ship Swing Copter of doom.

levels.name: Time Extreme
levels.description: The second part of Vortrox's superbuffed Robtop levels series. The level mainly follows the layout of Time Machine with much harder gameplay. Similarly to Stereo Extremeness, it also contains a difficult robot part in the second half.

levels.name: ASHES
levels.description: A level reflecting the creator’s struggle with mental health. Starts off extremely difficult and becomes easier as it progresses. Features an exceptionally high cps.

levels.name: In The Generator
levels.description: A solo extreme made in the 2.0GDPS. Has an upbeat electricity/factory theme with a very faithful 2.0 aesthetic. The gameplay is mainly skill based, with some very tight precision ship sections.

levels.name: Honeycrisp
levels.description: A 1.9-inspired solo extreme featuring first half-heavy gameplay, difficult fast-paced wave sections and many chokepoints.

levels.name: The Fog
levels.description: An atmospheric megacollab where the player traverses through ancient ruins whilst shrouded by dense fog. The gameplay is cube only and is heavily timing-based without using any spikes. It progressively gets more fast-paced and colourful until the ending where the sun breaks through and the fog clears as you leave the ruins behind.

levels.name: Devotion
levels.description: This 2.1 extreme is the second level in the Rededication Series, which is inspired by Nikrodox's Dedication series. This level has been in the works since 2018, initially being known as "Paradox".

levels.name: Twisted Titanium
levels.description: Third and final level of the Tempered Steel trilogy. Verified by spcreat. (Video set as verification is a showcase)

levels.name: Golden Flare
levels.description: XL memory + circles extreme heavily inspired by Golden Paracosm & Bausha Vortex. Features cluttered structuring and a consistent bright yellow palette. Its also Krakow's first rate!

levels.name: Controlled Chaos
levels.description: Vibrant red & green 2.0-esque masterpiece. Memorable for its incredibly well-executed gameplay gimmicks and consistent, high-quality designs. Includes numerous instances of creatively moving and interactive gameplay as well as immersive technology-inspired backgrounds.

levels.name: Perfect Purgatory
levels.description: A slaughterhouse remake by TheBigCheese and Shizusss using a song that was trending on social media for a while.

levels.name: agg challenge 18
levels.description: Lofi art extreme made for their friend agg's birthday. Contains many birds!

levels.name: Echoes of Neon
levels.description: A remake of Forsaken Neon and MinAY's proudest megacollab project. It has the original level's colour scheme, slope-oriented structures, large orb clusters and speed portals, while overhauling the decoration with modern tech-based designs and an extension which nearly doubles its length.

levels.name: Luminosity
levels.description: Atmospheric light themed extreme creatively using pads, portals & jump-rings as decoration. Contains difficult swing sections and flowy orb-based gameplay with bright particle-based backgrounds.

levels.name: Ascension
levels.description: A four minute long rainbow level to the tune of Abracadavre from Call of Duty: Black Ops Zombies. A passion project seven years in the making with detailed rainbow designs, interesting line art, and hard gameplay throughout. One of the rawest extremes in the game.

levels.name: Glory
levels.description: A Christian megacollab hosted by Entique, intended to remind everyone of God's love and glory. The level itself is a purple glow-flow with an upbeat Colbreakz song.

levels.name: Next Stage
levels.description: Zipixbox and TMco collab that is the successor to Heavens Door. Inspired by the Stage 4 boss from I Wanna Kill The Kamilia 3, and a 2.0 level of the same name. Features flashbacks to various older levels in reference to the IWKTK3 bossfight, as well as fully randomized bullet hell styled parts.

levels.name: 0 Techno
levels.description: Cherryteam collab hosted by MinAY, 'designed to make your eyes bleed'. Verification video is a placeholder showcase

levels.name: lacy
levels.description: Calm pink XL megacollab to the tune of Lacy by Olivia Rodrigo. Has an asymmetrical dual in the middle where your icon can land on your ship.

levels.name: POW
levels.description: Super spammy level that is the sequel to WOW

levels.name: SOLEIL
levels.description: Well received solo design-art-effect level centered around the sun, moon, and stars. Known to progressively get more difficult, and also have chokepoints in the break part at 44%.

levels.name: lovel
levels.description: Love themed memory & design level with a mostly hot pink colour scheme. The hardest part is the drop with an incredibly difficult mini wave dual. It was made for valentines day, but was a few days late with its release.

levels.name: Video
levels.description: An 8 minute long level themed around MaxxoRMeN's experiences with internet addiction. It has a randomised minigame section where you have to look out for Mr. Wireless and is accompanied by nearly a minute of difficult fast-paced gameplay in the intro and a high-energy drop with a learny dual 6 minutes in. Extremely well-received for its progression and song representation.

levels.name: TURN THE LIGHTS OFF
levels.description: Zeronium CC entry that uses a Tally Hall song about puberty. The predrop and intermission are shrouded in darkness to match the name (someone turned the lights off). Said parts are also the hardest.

levels.name: I Cry
levels.description: The first level in Tacos' 1.9 GDPS Earth Circles series. Features unique Frutiger Aero decoration and includes a 'choose your path section' in the second half as well as a memory part.

levels.name: Diamond Disco
levels.description: A pure solo extreme one year in the making, notable for its high-CPS clicksync gameplay, an incredibly mesmerising dual and its colour bass-complextro hybrid song. It focuses heavily on song representation, and uses editor particles, bright flashes, screen effects, complementary colours and player movements to create the vibe of a loud EDM disco party.

levels.name: Funnyname Funnygame
levels.description: A three minute long 1.9 effect style solo level that took over two years to create, with parts very reminiscent of Lightwave. The difficulty increases as the level progresses, and the second half features some beautifully janky duals and the infamous Lightwave wave. Has become an insider meme in Aredl for its 1.9 fever dream-like style and low victor count.

levels.name: Floating Outskirts
levels.description: Technically impressive Pre-platformer platformer level made completely in 2.1. Contains 10 unique sections, each with their own gimmick and environment. Notoriously difficult to control, but satisfying to pull off.

levels.name: Agony
levels.description: A Congregation-inspired solo extreme which, as the name suggests, is themed around agony with its bright flashes, flesh-like designs and an appropriately-chosen song. Its decoration is made mostly out of the 2.2 pixel objects, and hence it has a surprisingly low object count despite its level of detail and its length.

levels.name: Dualies
levels.description: 1-minute layout by Gablor which was decoed by multiple creators. Visually inspired from 2.0 levels and Plasma Pulse Finale. Features mirror portal gameplay in an unorthodox manner.

levels.name: DESOLATE
levels.description: Cube-based extreme themed around a stormy city. Somewhat gradually increases in intensity, but retains a dark and lonely atmosphere throughout.

levels.name: REDEEMER
levels.description: A 7 minute long extreme where giant humanoid spirits are released from their tombs, destroying the earth as they ascend. Widely praised for its atmosphere, storytelling, and song representation. The gameplay is very gimmicky, and features a very hard central section and an asymmetrical ship dual at the end.

levels.name: SHOWDOWN (berrytg)
levels.description: Flow megacollab using xKore - Showdown that is extremely reminiscent of Saul Goodman, even having the infamous upwards wave corridor at the end. As such, it is very learny with many moving objects and has many tough wave sections.

levels.name: Auroral Ascent
levels.description: Well-received clicksync solo extreme aimed to be a more accessible level in Nexel's catalogue. Consists of a subdued color palette and an intense dual in the second half.

levels.name: Visurient
levels.description: Really old 2.1 level that was made for their friend Visurient. Took a few years to get rated.

levels.name: Magnificent Gaps
levels.description: A magnificent remake of Impossible Gaps with a lot of finicky gimmicks and a short 2 player part. The level is fully ship gamemode with simple cute designs and visuals. The lord of chokepoints and raw skill gameplay, johnnwaogus magnificent masterpiece

levels.name: Hyperliminal
levels.description: Vibrant solo extreme making good use of shaders and 2.2 triggers. Consists of bright flashes, unique designs and complex color schemes. With an enjoyment rating of over 90, the 12 playtesters clearly did their job well!

levels.name: Bordon Factory
levels.description: Minimalistic factory themed level that uses gameplay to its fullest potential. Contains multiple gimmicky sections and a randomised bossfight.

levels.name: Io
levels.description: Warm-toned 1.9 extreme loosely themed around the highly volcanically active moon Io. Hardest level in Latezk's moons-of-Jupiter series. Features a very gnarly dual at 80%.

levels.name: Voyager 1
levels.description: A 2.0 styled megacollab one year in the making, encapsulating a variety of decoration styles and gameplay tropes from that era. Throughout its 2 and a half minute runtime it features raw decoration, moving objects and bizarre duals galore, and paired with an old Bossfight song makes for a charming and authentic experience.

levels.name: Gateway
levels.description: Solo extreme with unconventional but intuitive well-received gameplay. Surprisingly Eveteer's first finished level! Notable for its creative effects, good music representation and unique atmosphere.

levels.name: Nostalgia
levels.description: Slow paced timing extreme with a light gold tint made for the KrmaL contest 3.

levels.name: Voltage (Hypno)
levels.description: Contrary to ThePurgatory's "Voltage," Hypno's memory megacollab consists of incredibly unique gameplay and visuals. Specifically, it combines traditional design with extremely unorthodox symmetrical-ish gameplay and structuring, making for a particularly learny and satisfying experience.

levels.name: Necrocide
levels.description: Semi-forgotten Zylenox extreme that went unrated for 4 years. Memorable for its hyper-detailed designs and surprising edginess for the time.

levels.name: Lovestruck
levels.description: Love-themed sequel to Voltage featuring unconventional, heart filled decoration. Built among close friends including popular creators like Pocke, Loltad, & Shmigels. Memorable for its bubbly colors and impossibly memorization-heavy gameplay. Features a unique final ship in which all creators constructed blocky hearts to weave between.

levels.name: Supreme Demon Mix
levels.description: A reimagining of Zobros' "Ultimate Demon Mix", often containing fast-paced gameplay requiring a variety of skillsets. Each part of the level is styled after one of 23 different demons.

levels.name: Cheyenne
levels.description: The sequel to the Insane Demon Apache, featuring blinding decoration with an extremely intense song. Started in 2018 and was reworked multiple times.

levels.name: milo
levels.description: A Classic styled xSlendy level seemingly inspired by Saul Goodman. Startpos: 120275555

levels.name: Loose Screws
levels.description: Incredibly creative and unpolished extreme with alternative memory gameplay and extremely chaotic decoration, both of which inspired by Toxin Lab III. Features a difficult wave maze and an intimidating predrop. Despite its quirks, the gameplay is very highly regarded among victors!

levels.name: Khorne
levels.description: Legendary extreme demon with a very rich history. The original version created by Hota1991 had around a million objects, the most out of any level of its time. Because of how laggy the level was for most people, Stilluetto created an nerfed optimized version, cutting the object count in half. The original version was rated twice on accident, once in 2023 and again in 2026 right before the optimized version got rated. The level is split into nine parts, each exploring a different part of hell.

levels.name: reset your mind
levels.description: Glitchy & hyper-dense solo 1.9 styled level about what the level's name suggests. Memorable for its fun, unconventional memory gameplay and claustrophobic structuring that might appear as object spam at first.

levels.name: Carmine Cascade
levels.description: Scarlet Surge remake with the signature deep red flashy pulses. Features much more memory heavy gameplay than the original, in AAAAAlex's signature style. Extremely well received despite technically being a superbuffed 7 star.

levels.name: Twilight Coexistence
levels.description: Relatively unknown Korean duo level notable for its extremely fast-paced dual gameplay. Contains neo-design adjacent decoration with an inconsistent pink and blue palette.

levels.name: Cryothorn Hell
levels.description: An  ice-themed remaster of Sakupen Hell, containing the same gameplay with some alterations, including the addition of a difficult wave extension and a chokable cube section near the end.

levels.name: Tunnel
levels.description: An extremely large megacollab of 193 people, hosted by Akunakun, where each creator has a 3 block long part. The gameplay is corridor based.

levels.name: dance (Solo)
levels.description: Solo created and verified 2-player level made for Lia's and Gecko's 2P Creator Contest, using a song from a Persona 4 spin-off game. The gameplay is entirely clicksync and very learny. The drop, from 33%-42%, is by far the hardest part.

levels.name: Masterpiece
levels.description: An open ended solo level that is intended to run alongside vRidge's other extreme To The Blue Moon.

levels.name: The Old Trail
levels.description: Solo intended XL 2p level by Bram4Real, inspired by his own experience in trail hiking. The level has hard timing gameplay for the predrop and drop, and then turns into a 2p dual for the rest.

levels.name: S3NT1M3NT
levels.description: A short and fast paced ATOMIC CANNON inspired solo level by AREDL list leader Shyne! Features names of many AREDL members throughout, a horizontal spider orb, and has an infamously hard wave near the end. Has become a large insider meme in AREDL, and additionally took 6 months and 33 opinions to place on NLW...

levels.name: Summer Sky
levels.description: XL solo extreme featuring clean sky themed decoration and click sync gameplay

levels.name: Coolie Mazie Paloozi
levels.description: Dense & colorful memory extreme created by the feared memory creator Akunakun and verified by the beloved youtuber Tride. Includes 12 large, distinct, and extremely confusing mazes.

levels.name: Nautilus
levels.description: Tabgnid's first solo level, a 1.9-style extreme with flow gameplay inspired by Prismatic Haze.

levels.name: Vertigo (notLevo)
levels.description: An early 2.1 extreme demon that took 8 years to be rated. The gameplay has scattered chokepoints, with the middle of the level being much harder than the rest of the level.

levels.name: THE PRINCE
levels.description: Repetition-based memory extreme using a Madeon song and only cube, robot and ball for its gamemodes. It's reminiscent of the Sunset Sandstorm predrop, with deviations between the same repeated pattern to match the song. The 2nd half is a nerve wracking ball section that is very chokable.

levels.name: Delicious Dogs
levels.description: A megacollab themed around early 2.1 levels, containing stereotypical decoration and gameplay elements inspired by its reference time period. It took nearly a year for the level to finally get rated.

levels.name: ACHROMATISM
levels.description: 2.2 Prismatic Haze remake that also doubles as the first Turkish solo extreme demon ever!

levels.name: Absolute Solver
levels.description: Murder Drones themed level with a nightcore-metal song from the final episode. Involves numerous references from the show and many flashy, tech themed effects. Although incredibly learny, the gameplay is highly praised.

levels.name: Chromatic
levels.description: The official sequel to Prismatic by CatGeo made by a different creator. The gameplay differs with its faster gameplay and difficult ship parts. The decoration has much more variation in it including a complete tone shift at 64%. 2nd Parfait extreme.

levels.name: Advent Aurora
levels.description: The last Extreme Demon uploaded in 2.1; A colorful, glowy, and vaguely aurora-themed level, described by the creator as a "floating world under the moonlight."

levels.name: help
levels.description: A-

levels.name: UnveiL
levels.description: Shiver me timbers, be that an XXL pirate themed megacollab! Yahar matey! (full creator list will be added soon)

levels.name: Revolution 1993
levels.description: Solo XXL+ extreme to the tune of Revolution 1993 by Jamiroquai. Features many dual sections over its 10 minute runtime. Come on, fight the power!

levels.name: Le Midd Mapperoonies
levels.description: A three minute long non stop memory level. Gets gradually harder as the level progresses, with a very hard wave near the end. Received a balance update in late 2024 which both buffed the first half and nerfed the second half, easing the difficulty increase through the level.

levels.name: Game Over
levels.description: A very unorthodox level featuring an abundance of difficult timings in the first section, becoming a high-CPS wave consistency challenge in the second section that tests the player's stamina and spam skill.

levels.name: Inside
levels.description: Hypno's second solo Extreme Demon project, inspired by the rhythm game Sayonara Wild Hearts. It showcases Hypno's signature gameplay style: learny yet intuitive, focused on unique structuring. Noteworthy for its difficult duals, exceptional song representation and simplistic neon designs.

levels.name: Ecstasy (SleyGD)
levels.description: Very flashy solo extreme you'll regret opening the editor on due to the sheer amount of triggers. The difficulty features varied gameplay, with a dual lasting from 65 all the way to the end giving it an easy but chokeable ending.

levels.name: Siniristi
levels.description: Super big early 2.0 megacollab with, some say it was even the biggest one (probably). (Verification video was privated/deleted)

levels.name: Motorbreath
levels.description: Colorful skill-based extreme using a Metallica song with very high-cps clicksync gameplay. Contains a difficult predrop and an intimidating cube maze at 84%.

levels.name: Blue Suns Zenith
levels.description: Incredibly creative extreme inspired by Magic The Gathering, using Blue Zenith by xi as its song. Memorable for its difficult sideways wave among other unique gameplay gimmicks. Glory to Phyrexia

levels.name: Grind District
levels.description: A 1.9 style memory extreme made by Airz while they were working on Skeletal Shenanigans. Features a very difficult second half.

levels.name: Blueprint
levels.description: Another Waterbound solo that now utilizes more gimmicks like the Beach Ball and the Shwave. It includes a randomized Minesweeper pattern at the end that you have to solve in order to hit the right toggle orb at the end. Also has one of the most evil last clicks in any extreme demon in this range.

levels.name: OUCH
levels.description: Fire themed megacollab with a variety of well known creators, using a buffed Shmigels layout. This level also has randomised memory gimmick where a number at 28% tells you how many times to jump at 33%.

levels.name: Dyad
levels.description: A solo XXL extreme where you race your friend to the moon! Created for the Zeronium creator contest, this level features four contrasting sections, repetitive sync gameplay, and a lot of character and personality.

levels.name: i just wish i could
levels.description: Solo intended 2p extreme by Snoozzzing. This level was made as three separate levels, eventually combined into one. The level is about their experience with suicidal ideation and perseverance. The decoration was inspired by sink and 5ta1ker.

levels.name: Sakupen Joy
levels.description: A joyous remake of the famous extreme demon Sakupen Hell with a brighter color palette, a different song, and a boss fight!

levels.name: SLAM
levels.description: Timing extreme in Darwin's classic bright design/effect style. Zoink's easiest level

levels.name: SUPERCONDUCTOR
levels.description: Extremely high cps solo level by At424. The spider and wave are very high cps, demanding a lot of stamina.

levels.name: Distortion
levels.description: Colorful maymory memory map created by finley and friends.

levels.name: Wayback Array
levels.description: Fast, upbeat and fun megacollab started 'way back' in 2019. Took 4 years to complete and another 2 years to get rated.

levels.name: One5Seven
levels.description: Fully solo made level by Sdslayer that changes decoration style every couple parts. Gameplay is mostly carried by click-sync but has a few notable chokepoints scattered throughout.

levels.name: Tron
levels.description: The first Extreme Demon made by the legendary creator FunnyGame, themed around the sci-fi series of the same name. The gameplay is often considered to be of poor quality, and the level contains a long cutscene at the beginning.

levels.name: Callisto
levels.description: 1.9 style extreme memorable for its incredibly satisfying and well-received gameplay. One of the four levels by Latezk named after Jupiter's four largest moons.

levels.name: shattered lens
levels.description: A collab between XDjoa and SoggyDash for the Zeronium CC2! Features stinking greyscale effects and fast paced, dual heavy gameplay throughout.

levels.name: CLOWNS
levels.description: Bright and colourful circus themed solo extreme that took 2 years to get rated.

levels.name: Techno Disco
levels.description: Sequel of Techno Flashes that uses the same song. Upgrades the its predecessors decoration by incorporating more complex neon designs and by increasing the energy. The second half features a rainbow color palette and the Flashback Zone™ incase you forgot its a sequel to Techno Flashes.

levels.name: Fever Dream (ElirpscalionPC)
levels.description: Unique design extreme created and verified solo, gradually becoming messier and more dreamlike. Contains high-cps gameplay and difficult straight fly sections.

levels.name: same old
levels.description: Simple & effective design extreme with a distinct RGBY color scheme. Has many repetitive memory sections that pair well with the song, and also has a highly chaotic QuazeryIceCube style maze at the end with hundreds of possible routes.

levels.name: Karasu
levels.description: A collection of rejected Yatagarasu parts that took 6 years to get rated. It is the second level to feature Terron's bird. The level heavily relies on chokepoints and nerves.

levels.name: Antonymph
levels.description: An upbeat and colourful extreme set to ANTONYMPH by VyletPony

levels.name: 6LACKLIGHT
levels.description: *Epilepsy Warning*

levels.name: Treatment Facility
levels.description: 1.9 styled design level inspired by Toxic Sewers, themed around escaping an underground wastewater facility. Includes lots of subtle effects and movements to build immersion. References the infamous Rupture wave at 40%.

levels.name: super kontik
levels.description: Russian duo level featuring a flashy rainbow color scheme and fast-paced clicksync gameplay. Memorably contains a randomized robot section where you have to collect Super Kontik cookies. "best sandwich cookie you have probably ever seen in your life."

levels.name: GrizzlyWare
levels.description: Code themed solo extreme with a predominantly green and red colour scheme, inspired by Toxic Sewers, Rupture, and Controlled Chaos. The drop is mostly comprised of mirrored gameplay.

levels.name: FTW
levels.description: A 2.0 styled extreme demon with distinct wave sections, tricky ship parts, and diverse click patterns that resembles old styled gameplay, along with appealing yet somewhat simplistic decoration elements.

levels.name: Zenith (Lan IIVX)
levels.description: Solo XXL extreme with a variety of styles, themed around finding forgiveness for mistakes.

levels.name: All In
levels.description: Flowy clicksync extreme themed around gambling, featuring a consistent red and black color scheme with many references to cards and casinos.

levels.name: PISTON
levels.description: Solo extreme inspired by the piston from Minecraft! The pistons move the blocks in the level around, making for some interesting moving object heavy gameplay.

levels.name: gardening map
levels.description: Silly 2.1 memory collab with unorthodox gameplay and structuring and tons of tiny jokes and references. Beware the creature at 21%.

levels.name: wires
levels.description: Atmospheric & monochromatic robot-only extreme with a gloomy song by The Neighborhood. Takes subtle inspiration from Zylenox, featuring a fast-paced climax.

levels.name: I Wanted To Sleep
levels.description: A pure solo extreme heavily inspired by Eon clocking in at 20 minutes long. Many concepts from Eon are present here, and it takes advantage of its shorter length to experiment more with structures, designs and song representation without inflating its object count. Its gameplay is notable for 3 distinct fast-paced segments starting at 17.2%, 45.8% and 79%, separated by slower, easier gameplay.

levels.name: love0
levels.description: Unconventional breakup themed design level with unorthodox orb combinations and psychedelic visuals. Unfortunately the platformer checkpoint at 88% does not let you respawn...

levels.name: Perfect in Place
levels.description: Solo intended 2p level, created for someseal's solo 2p creator contest. The gameplay is high cps, frequently switching between 2p and 1p sections. It's grayscale and effect heavy decoration is based off of both an older unrated level by Jemma, and the Undertale "Disbelief" animation.

levels.name: Godspeed
levels.description: A fast paced megacollab co-hosted by MrFreckles and Rynoxious that has been in development since 2021!

levels.name: FURY TECH
levels.description: FRANK

levels.name: Momentary Affection
levels.description: The sequel to Lost Love that will really test your ability to memorize a path and ability to learn duals.

levels.name: BRAINROT
levels.description: Design style memory level using control: mind, and is somewhat reminiscent of Sleepless by ChaSe gameplay wise. Features some split path gameplay and a cube maze around the halfway point. Sadly has nothing to do with actual brainrot so do not expect to find Triple T or 67 kid.

levels.name: Endurance
levels.description: A faithful remake of Marathon, rebalanced to remove chokepoints and emphasize nerve buildup and consistency. The decoration gets gradually more complex as the level progresses

levels.name: Weald
levels.description: Peaceful woodland themed solo extreme featuring slow paced gameplay and an asymmetrical dual.

levels.name: Just A Bunch Of Idea
levels.description: Short extreme that switches styles halfway through, with one of the biggest wave chokepoints in its difficulty range.

levels.name: Avalanche (Filqh)
levels.description: BLBL inspired extreme demon originally made 4 years ago, now fully updated and reverified by DaMeister.

levels.name: Ergonomic Chair
levels.description: A chair designed for efficiency and comfort. (Purple and yellow extreme mainly featuring ship and wave gameplay, but also features a swing dual and a multi-creator triple trial at the end.)

levels.name: Specthys (2P)
levels.description: Solo 2p level made and verified by gBen, themed around astronomy with a mostly yellow scheme. Built with the intention to be played solo, and features a lot of ship control.

levels.name: Destinies
levels.description: A very long solo art level inspired by many other XL art levels such as Emerald Realm and Well Rested. The gameplay gets progressively faster paced and intense towards the end, and it features a lot of spider/spider orb gameplay. One of the most enjoyed extremes.

levels.name: HyperHyperHyperHyper
levels.description: Twan's first solo!!!

levels.name: Spacious Senses
levels.description: Memory extreme with QuazeryIceCube's signature freeform gameplay with many possible routes, and simple but effective decoration. The first half contains most of the difficulty, and a handful of timing chokepoints.

levels.name: ONVIL FACTORY
levels.description: A solo extreme by Cordeaux dedicated to fellow creator Onvil for their birthday!

levels.name: recollection
levels.description: High energy memory megacollab verified by LordVadercraft with flashy effects and dense, rainbow filled decoration. Has a notoriously difficult last click.

levels.name: Sleepwalking
levels.description: Waterbound's second extreme demon, this time created in a minimal but atmospheric design in 24 hours. Uses only the cube gamemode once again.

levels.name: CRUEL
levels.description: Dark red castle themed Cherryteam collab, verified and published by Denni

levels.name: Thoughtless Space
levels.description: Remake of Thinking Space II, rated as a low end extreme demon. It was created as a solo level by KZLR at the request of his friend Neeple, who wanted to verify an extreme demon level. Features fast paced cube and ship gameplay with an infamously difficult last jump.

levels.name: Yeo Baek
levels.description: Modern solo extreme with a long and complex asymmetrical dual in the second half.

levels.name: Hades
levels.description: BOIII WHAT U SAY ABOUT PHONK??

levels.name: Zen Blast
levels.description: Extremely colourful and upbeat XL megacollab made by a friend group. Features learny 2.2 feature heavy gameplay, with some unorthodox flow at the drop. The decoration and gameplay are highly varied between parts, creating a very diverse playing experience. "Imagine a place where people of all walks of life can come together and bro down."

levels.name: Canneles au chocolat
levels.description: A modern mashup style level with 2.2 camera effects featuring a French dessert. The gameplay is mainly made up of click sync based timings with notably hard wave chokepoints.

levels.name: PAINFUL PLAYLAND
levels.description: Old impossible level inspired extreme featuring difficult, learny gameplay restricted to update 1.2. Received a significant nerfdate moving it down 300 spots in mid-2024. Contains lighthearted rainbow decoration while using the entirety of Dry Out.

levels.name: Four (shoe42)
levels.description: Colorful clicksync extreme themed around the symbol "four" in Japanese, having a similar pronunciation as the symbol "death." Known for having hard wave sections and fast-paced timings.

levels.name: Paranoid
levels.description: Flowy & clean design collab using a not-so-garbage rock song by the band Garbage. Memorable for its dynamic effects and movements paired with engaging and well-received gameplay. Also features fantastic color work! Verified by Zeronium.

levels.name: Brave
levels.description: Megacollab remake of Paladin by Asonicmen, and references Dragon Quest. Has faithful mid 2.1 design style decoration, and well rounded gameplay.

levels.name: Gentlemens Clique (2P)
levels.description: A 2-player level, a part of the gang trilogy. The level's name is meant to be a British version of Based Gang. Has a key you can collect to turn the bossfight icons into the Bass Cave demon.

levels.name: EXTREME MEMORY MIX
levels.description: You wouldn't believe it, but this level's an extreme memory mix. Interestingly, it remixes beginner to main list memory extremes while maintaining engaging and well-received gameplay & balancing. Notably chooses nicher memory extremes than other levels to "be cooler," such as Santa Fe, GO bird and Hollow.

levels.name: Haircut
levels.description: Collab hosted by Metalface221. Very unique sync-based level with bright effect decoration and one of the longest straight-flies of any rated extreme demon.

levels.name: KUB
levels.description: A minimalistic style level that is reflected both in the deco and the fact the level only uses the cube gamemode. Features a long intro cutscene and some punishing custom hitboxes.

levels.name: BYE
levels.description: A remake of Hi by KrmaL. The level was poorly received, and the creator asked for it to be deleted off the servers but was denied by moderators. As it's a buffed version of the original, the gameplay is gimmicky, chokepoint heavy, and has a very hard second half.

levels.name: MAKE ME SAD
levels.description: Solo extreme with light gradient decoration reminiscent of Rust. Has mainly timing based gameplay, and a ship at the end with a lot of orbs.

levels.name: your brain on brain
levels.description: Solo extreme with heavy rainbow decoration and a generally silly and playful theme. Features mostly timing based gameplay, with an emphasis on cube and robot. Was somehow insane demon for a week, causing it to place on the Insane Demon List as one of the hardest top 1s in its history. It was then promoted to extreme an hour later :trollface:

levels.name: PARANOIA (AAAAAlex)
levels.description: Originally an unfinished level named Tazz by Shocksidian, finished up and published by AAAAAlex

levels.name: Our Fountain
levels.description: A slow and very atmospheric XL extreme using an equally atmospheric song to match. Features detailed block designs and some memory sections. Gets generally harder as the level progresses, ending with a short, slow, but very narrow nine circles style wave.

levels.name: STARBREAKER
levels.description: The prequel to STARCRASH with gameplay made by SoggyCat and decorated by ClingingBog. Set in an abandoned city, where a star creation experiment is left unmaintained. The player must reach the top of the factory to stop this experiment, or the star will collapse. Notable for its high-CPS clicksync dual gameplay throughout the drop.

levels.name: Last Station
levels.description: A long and dark clicksync-based level, themed after trains in both it's deco and song. The gameplay is learny and heavy on timings, with some hard cube and ship gameplay.

levels.name: YIPPEE
levels.description: Enfur's first 2.2 level which uses a rainbow theme and is much more accessible than their other levels. YIPPEE!!!

levels.name: Northern Essence
levels.description: 1.9 Christmas-themed megacollab hosted by Youknowwho.

levels.name: Stasis
levels.description: Arraegen's entry in the Zeronium CC2 Creator Contest! Uses player colors for the colors of the decoration.

levels.name: Soundwave
levels.description: A level inspired by volume and made as an attribute to Metalface. Boost a couple similarities to Volume, most notably having a pretty difficult wave section in the middle of the level.

levels.name: Color Beam
levels.description: Bizaare's ode to the simpler side of Geometry Dash. An xl memory level using deliberately simple designs and subtle effects, and prioritising song representation above all else.

levels.name: The Gins II
levels.description: A first-half heavy sequel that's based off of a comedy-horror film of the same name. Features a variety of different fast-paced gameplay types, including a bossfight at 70%.

levels.name: Vertigo (PAHC)
levels.description: Most notable for its random offset gimmick, where the gameplay is offset from the visible decoration. Most of the difficulty comes from the gimmick, making this one of the most unique easy extremes. Due to the nature of the gimmick and how much easier this level is when fully visible, liveplay is required when submitting.

levels.name: Jail Break
levels.description: Solo extreme with over 200 hours of editor work where you break out of prison and traverse through forests and cityscapes as you attempt to escape the police. Its gameplay is full of gamemode switches and has a few camera gimmicks, and the deco has many easter eggs.

levels.name: Existentia
levels.description: "sorry for gameplay lol"

levels.name: THE GLITCHTON (Solo)
levels.description: Solo-intended 2p extreme, solo created by ranoutofusers. The deco is extremely bright and colourful, with the gameplay being 2nd half carried. This was users' first rate after getting 95 sends in total.

levels.name: LOOSE ENDS
levels.description: The second half is a bit harder than the first

levels.name: V O L L E Y
My Own Funeral
levels.description: A red effect solo extreme with an unsettling atmosphere. Contains a short memory section in the second half.

levels.name: Twilight Spire
levels.description: An older Loltad layout decorated in 2.2 by Loltad and IceRod. Features complex memory gameplay and uses the second half of Theory of Everything 2. Perhaps most notable for receiving an incredible twelve 100s in a row on EDEL. One of the most enjoyed extremes.

levels.name: SORRYNOTSORRY
levels.description: Very pink level built as the creator's first finished deco project, a level where you must party without being caught by the eyeball police. Contains many different kinds of gameplay and is generally well received.

levels.name: BROOKLYNBLOODPOP
levels.description: Bright rainbow design extreme known for its iconic hyperpop song and easily recognizable party-like visuals by StarkyTheSalad. The gameplay is well-received, consisting of learny & well-synced cube sections and clever fakes.

levels.name: MELTDOWN
levels.description: Darwin solo extreme from mid 2.1 reminiscent of Rupture, ToE2 and Blast Processing. Most well known for its absurd ship chokepoint at the drop, and the rest of the level plays more like an insane demon.

levels.name: Molten Iron
levels.description: Level by AZS, verified by BSIC999 in 7000 att. [Bug visual fixed]

levels.name: Tung Tung Sahurcles
levels.description: Tung Tung (Tung) Sahurcles. Verified by Nova4664!

levels.name: Cerebral Torment
levels.description: A solo extreme demon that has very bizarre, unconventional yet intriguing art decoration attached with a heavy amount of variety. The gameplay matches this decoration style by being heavily unorthodox.

levels.name: story 2
levels.description: Solo extreme by lazer that repeats sections of a small amount of gameplay, unlocking more sections when the time signature in the song changes. Difficulty spikes at the 60% wave.

levels.name: WHITE LIGHT
levels.description: Solo extreme by Kreno set to the Gorillaz song of the same name. Has a fully greyscale colour scheme and skill based gameplay.

levels.name: Hollow
levels.description: A unique minimalistic memory level using simple but effective block structures on a dark background. The gameplay is very freeform, and the large maze at the end has an immeasurable number of possible routes.

levels.name: Pro Lov Ad
levels.description: 6 minute solo memory extreme using the entirety of the eponymous Sweet Trip song, and featuring high quality early 2000s WindowsXP style deco inspired by the album cover. Has mostly ship gameplay through its runtime, much of which is 2.2 gravity, and has an unusual alternating blind clicksync wave. Made memory through it's confusing, constantly moving, and highly obscured gameplay (Including hiding your icon behind jumpingcat3.png).

levels.name: smohcs
levels.description: The long standing top 1 on the Insane Demon List before getting promoted. A 1.9 memory level built to showcase the update's capabilities instead of trying to look like a 1.9 level. Has two endings, though the 'good ending' requires a tough frame perfect timing far into the level.

levels.name: my worst level
levels.description: May or may not be MrPoopyBurger's worst level...

levels.name: Melancholy
levels.description: Dark and emotional XXL+ solo level with minimalistic but effective decoration. Nearly entirely greyscale, but gains a small but meaningful amount of colour at the second drop. The gameplay is heavily endurance based, and has multiple split paths and frequent timings. Took 4 years to get featured.

levels.name: A Fleeting Reverie
levels.description: Exscher's first serious attempt at getting a rated level. An insanely detailed art level with some small two player segments.

levels.name: Supernova
levels.description: A beginner 1.9PS extreme demon megacollab. Manages to capture the essence of old megacollabs such as Supersonic with its varied decoration styles. Has an all-around fast-paced gameplay style with difficult ship and old swingcopter sections. Each part was built only after the previous part had been completed.

levels.name: IGAKU
levels.description: Predominantly greyscale modern level with a Kasane Teto song! Contains some confusing memory parts and a few camera flips.

levels.name: eclipse
levels.description: Very bright and intense space rainbow level in Vit12's signature style. Also contains Vit's signature simple, skillbased gameplay style which can be divisive, though this time with better transitions and playtesting.

levels.name: Hazy Memories
levels.description: Complex & intuitive memory extreme with unconventional, flowy gameplay. Features unique gameplay tropes like breakable blocks and a ship section controlled by a green orb. Gameplay is extremely well-received.

levels.name: The Depths Above
levels.description: A solo extreme themed around the game Outer Wilds. The gameplay is gimmicky with some hard timings and varying gravity, and there's a minigame section based on the game before the drop.

levels.name: Crimson Citadel
levels.description: A remake to ZenthicAlpha's hard demon, Crimson Chamber. Heavily revamps the gameplay with 2.2 mechanics, and updates the decoration while staying true to the original. The gameplay balancing is all-around with some difficult dual sections.

levels.name: mischievousmechanism
levels.description: A design deco factory-themed extreme demon, with many different unique gimmicks throughout. The difficulty is heavily carried by the wave section at 66%, and it's overall very learny.

levels.name: Artificial Climb
levels.description: A red and gray-colored beginner megacollab extreme that captures the style of old 2.0 levels with both its decoration being influenced by Artificial Ideology, and its unconventional gameplay style. The gameplay itself is all-around, though the wave parts are slightly more difficult.

levels.name: Freedom16
levels.description: Freedom08 remake built entirely in the 1.6 editor. Showcases a variety of deco and gameplay styles throughout its 4 minute length, however sacrifices some of its intensity as the entire level is in 1x speed.

levels.name: Fallen Horizon
levels.description: An extreme demon focused on ship, timings and swingcopter gameplay that is highly received, with a satisfying flow. The art decoration has a theming of a submerged and overgrown city that the player falls into after the first third.

levels.name: Devils Disco
levels.description: A very well-received extreme demon. The fast-paced, all-around gameplay of the level is highly learny and requires high CPS. The decoration is colorful, and it focuses on vibrant designs and effects which add to the intensity of the level.

levels.name: ReVolution Unleashed
levels.description: An extreme demon which has a very well-regarded theming of a desolate and decaying urban world captured through its purely greyscale coloring, design and art decoration style and the very fitting song-choice. The gameplay has been criticised for feeling tedious.

levels.name: Erosion
levels.description: Sequel to the insane demon Corrosion. The decoration is of a similar style to its predecessor, altered to reflect the heightened intensity of the song. Builds off of Corrosion's gameplay through an increase in difficult timings, a faster pace and higher complexity through the use of 2.2 mechanics.

levels.name: 4 Matilda
levels.description: The final level in the For Matilda series. Features a mixture of design and art decoration which makes every segment distinct. The gameplay is timings-based and has an unconventional style. The final part of the level is a precise minigame section where multiple cubes have differing zooms and angles.

levels.name: Me Lin A
levels.description: A sequel to insane demon Lin Anya. Features mostly all-around learny gameplay, though the ship is more prominent than the other gamemodes. The level mixes design, art and effect decoration with its vibrant and colorful glow style.

levels.name: Cold Level Go BRRRR
levels.description: An extreme demon with a light-hearted frosty theming, having vibrant and varied shades of blue as well as a mixture of effect and design decoration. The gameplay is fast-paced and features all-around learny gameplay.

levels.name: Bang Gang (2P)
levels.description: The first 2-player extreme in Geometry Dash. Was verified by four different people swapping positions mid-completion. The decoration is in DanZmeN's typicial 2019 style. Features learny segments and a bossfight with arrows that are not entirely accurate. The first victor, Grey479 is also the verifier for the level's solo completion, with them being awarded $3,000 AUD for it.

levels.name: Based Gang (2P)
levels.description: A 2-player level that takes inspiration from Bang Gang. In order to make it more feasible to do solo, as the final 20% can be nerfed in exchange for not getting the coin. Despite this, it's still the hardest part of the level when done solo.

levels.name: The Winged Sword
levels.description: A 1.9-style solo extreme with various styles of decoration throughout. Has generally skill-based ship and timings gameplay, with a difficult dual part at the drop.

levels.name: Jumping Demons
levels.description: A solo extreme by smarted, themed as a lost pilot animation made in the analog VHS era, inspired by the Jumping Devils song animation. The deco has a lot of custom lineart and effects. The gameplay consists of sync-based duals, and changes direction a lot throughout the level.

levels.name: Monitor
levels.description: A 3 minute long pure solo extreme using a pixelation effect where each pixel is visibly split into its RGB subpixels, much like how actual monitor screens work. Its base gameplay is relatively simple for its difficulty though it gets more complex in the second half with asymmetrical duals.

levels.name: White Album
levels.description: A slow-paced, atmospheric insane demon with a winter theming that's captured by its song and decoration. The gameplay later on in the level is much more difficult compared to the first third of it, as the final wave and cube sections feature very tight gaps. The last click is especially difficult.

levels.name: MONITORING
levels.description: Miku level

levels.name: in canon
levels.description: Unique memory level where the gameplay on the top and bottom half is the same but offset by five blocks.
